matchingNote: Every markPassed operation carries requiredEvidenceAny. A show name alone does not prove whose show it is, so each candidate must ALSO carry the organizer or town in a STRUCTURED field: location or organizer. Notes are deliberately not searched, because prose negates -- a note reading 'nothing to do with The Rustic Fox' would satisfy a substring test as well as one reading 'run by The Rustic Fox'. A record whose name matches but whose location/organizer does not identify it is excluded and reported by name in the preview.

correctionNote: v1 matched The Last Fling on exact normalized name + startDate. The live record is named 'The Last Fling Artisan Market', which is not equal to 'The Last Fling', so the match missed and the operation fell through to CREATE. v2 matches on nameContains 'last fling' AND startDate 2026-08-30 AND location/organizer evidence identifying Valley Ridge Golf Course or Antioch IL. All three must agree, so a different Last Fling on another date or at another venue is untouched. keepExistingName preserves the organizer's actual event name rather than renaming it to the shorter name on the sheet.
